description.en: Symptoms following exposure to traumatic event
description.hi: आघातजनक घटना के संपर्क में आने के बाद लक्षण

mappingNote: ICD-11 PTSD is 6B40; Complex PTSD (6B41) has no separately named DSM-5-TR diagnosis. DSM acute stress disorder is not equivalent to ICD acute stress reaction (QE84), which sits outside Chapter 06 (index 6.1.2-6.1.3).
